=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2402-2424, 2486-2503 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When SCOPE_ROUTE_ACTIVE is true, the rollbacks after a failed combined `gh issue edit` (around lines 2416-2424) and after a failed comment post (around lines 2498-2500) remove `ai:scope-blocked` without checking whether this run added it, so they can strip a latch that was already there (a kept planning latch or an implement-time latch from scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:221-225).
  WHY: The issue then resolves to stop=blocked instead of scope-blocked (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:139-142, 428-430), so override_guard is no longer offered, and an implement-time latch is silently disarmed with no marker posted (implement.yml line 2400 stops refusing). Reviewers disagreed on severity: openai_gpt-6-luna said MAJOR, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said LOW, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 said NIT. The highest (MAJOR) is used here. They also disagreed on whether gh applies label adds and removes in one request: sonnet says no, while minimax and gemini say a failed edit applies nothing. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed the finding because both rollbacks are gated on SCOPE_ROUTE_ACTIVE (plan.yml:2420-2423, 2498-2501).
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1057-1066, 3091-3093 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The planning-stage `ai:scope-blocked` latch is only removed by /answer answer-release (when release=true) or by the unblock judge's reset_ops grant; the plan-success step (plan.yml:3091-3093) never removes it, so a valid re-plan after answer-release keeps the latch (identity_unavailable, unreadable, no_rejection, newest_not_planning) ends at ai:awaiting-approval plus ai:scope-blocked.
  WHY: implement.yml:2400-2405 refuses to redispatch any issue carrying ai:scope-blocked, so a valid plan waits for a person, which is the stall class the issue set out to remove. All three flaggers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputed it: stop_for_labels still resolves the issue to stop=scope-blocked, so the unblock judge's override_guard reset reaches _approve, and keeping the latch is the documented fail-closed choice.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:251-263 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The answer-release trust check in `psbr_answer_release` ignores guard-rejection markers posted by anyone other than the pipeline login, so a foreign but valid-looking marker could lead to release=true, against the trust rule in `unblock_ledger.latest_rejection`.
  WHY: The source rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed it: latest_rejection reports reason=untrusted only when there is no trusted rejection (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:597-610), and answer-release then also fails closed with no_rejection, so the two agree.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:127 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `ai:scope-blocked` is now also used as a planning-stage latch, but the label catalogue description and the implement.yml:2401 operator message still describe only the implement-time meaning.
  WHY: An operator who finds the label on a planning-stage block is pointed at staged files and an earlier scope rejection that never happened. The source rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: “No new GitHub API calls.”
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml, the `/answer` transition and “Handle blocked planning output” steps
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The `/answer` transition adds `gh api user` at line 1060, the routed handler calls `ensure_label_exists` at line 2405, which invokes `gh label create` in `scripts/label_helpers.sh` lines 193-200, and the changelog documents one label-create call per routed block. (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 treated the `gh api user` read as a documented, deliberate deviation recorded as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, not a gap.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:"Handle blocked planning output" lines 2421, 2500 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The rollback assumes this run added ai:scope-blocked, but the label can already be on the issue when the step runs. This happens when an earlier /answer kept the latch (answer-release returned identity_unavailable, unreadable or newest_not_planning; lines 1057-1066) or when the issue carries an implement-time latch. A failed edit or comment post then removes that existing latch, and no new marker is posted.
  WHY: The item then resolves to stop=blocked instead of scope-blocked (unblock_ledger.py lines 139-142, 428-430), so override_guard is no longer offered, and an implement-time latch no longer stops redispatch (implement.yml line 2400). This needs a transient failure after gh_retry has given up. The pass-1 claim that gh applies label adds and removes in one request is not correct; the in-code comment at lines 2417-2418 is right.
- Checked and dropped: pass-1 finding 3 (the answer-release "untrusted" divergence, scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh lines 251-263) and pass-1 finding 1 (the kept planning latch strands the issue at implement; stop_for_labels still resolves to scope-blocked, so override_guard reaches _approve). The reset_ops change in scripts/unblock_actions.py produces the same output as before.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The `gh api user` read is a documented deliberate deviation (TASK_GAP_DEFERRED).
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/plan.yml, the gate that sets SCOPE_ROUTE_ACTIVE=true (line 2406) and the rollbacks at lines 2421 and 2500. Set SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING from `jq -e 'any(.labels[]?.name; . == "ai:scope-blocked")' "${ISSUE_META_FILE}"` and skip both removals when it is true (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:lines 1057-1066 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: ai:scope-blocked is added during a blocked planning run, but later successful planning runs that do not go through the unblock judge or answer-release path do not clear it.
  WHY: The stale label misleads the orchestrator and can block autonomous progress or stall the issue in planning.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:lines 251-263 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The answer-release trust check in `psbr_answer_release` ignores guard-rejection markers posted by any user other than the pipeline itself.
  WHY: A valid-looking but unauthorized marker from another user could set release=true, overriding the trust rule in `unblock_ledger.latest_rejection`.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:lines 2412-2424 (rollback label edit) and lines 2494-2503 (comment rollback) | severity=LOW | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The failure handling wrongly assumes `gh issue edit` applies label adds and removes non-atomically, and its rollback can remove a pre-existing `ai:scope-blocked` label that this run did not add.
  WHY: The issue then resolves as "blocked" instead of "scope-blocked" (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:139-142), so the unblock judge no longer offers `override_guard`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:plan.yml:1057-1066, plan.yml:3091-3093, .github/workflows/implement.yml:2400-2405 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Only the unblock judge grant (`scripts/unblock_actions.py:825-838`, `reset_ops`) and /answer answer-release remove the planning-stage `ai:scope-blocked` latch. The plan-success step (plan.yml:3091-3093) does not, so when answer-release keeps the latch (identity_unavailable, unreadable, no_rejection or newest_not_planning; `scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:236-275`), a successful plan leaves the issue at ai:awaiting-approval plus ai:scope-blocked.
  WHY: implement.yml:2400-2405 refuses to redispatch, and the orchestrator treats the label as a human-gated latch (`scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1605-1619`), so a valid plan waits for a person. Suggested fix: drop the label in plan-success when the newest trusted rejection is the planning scope marker.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:plan.yml:2416-2424, plan.yml:2486-2490 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The rollback removes `ai:scope-blocked` whenever the combined `gh issue edit` fails while routing is active, without checking that this run added it. Because `gh issue edit` sends one update, a failed call applied nothing, so the removal deletes a latch from an earlier run or an implement-time latch (`scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:221-225`).
  WHY: The issue keeps ai:planning, no marker is posted, the stop resolves as `blocked` (`scripts/unblock_ledger.py:139-142`), override_guard is no longer offered, and an implement-time latch is silently disarmed.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:scripts/label_helpers.sh:127, .github/workflows/implement.yml:2401 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `ai:scope-blocked` is reused as a planning-stage latch, but the label description and the implement operator message describe only the implement-time meaning.
  WHY: For a planning-stage block, the operator guidance points at the wrong event.
- Checked and dropped: the pass-1 answer-release trust divergence (unblock_ledger.py:597-610).
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE.
- HARDENING (2 related items): (1) scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh `psbr_answer_release` (lines 251-275) does not mirror the ledger's verdict-staleness rule (`scripts/unblock_ledger.py:601-613`). Track the newest trusted `ai:unblock:v1` verdict and keep the latch when the rejection is not newer (about 6 lines). (2) .github/workflows/plan.yml lines 2416-2424: the rollback outcome cannot be seen in the run log. Echo a `PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK outcome=label_edit_failed scope_label_removed=true|false` line (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2402-2407, 2417-2421 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `SCOPE_ROUTE_ACTIVE` records that routing is active, not that this run added `ai:scope-blocked`, so the edit-failure cleanup removes a label that was already there. The comment-post failure cleanup at 2498-2500 has the same issue.
  WHY: A transient failure can erase an existing scope-guard latch without an `override_guard` grant, and the issue loses the state the unblock judge needs to offer that grant.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “No new GitHub API calls.”
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/plan.yml, the `/answer` transition and “Handle blocked planning output” steps.
  Evidence of absence: The `/answer` transition adds `gh api user` at line 1060. The routed handler calls `ensure_label_exists` at line 2405, which invokes `gh label create` in `scripts/label_helpers.sh` lines 193-200. The changelog documents one label-create call per routed block.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

  PROBLEM: The planning-stage `ai:scope-blocked` latch is removed only by /answer answer-release (when release=true) and by the judge's `reset_ops` grant. The plan-success path (plan.yml:3091-3093) never removes it, and answer-release fails closed on realistic paths (identity_unavailable at scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:245-246, an unreadable comments file, newest_not_planning).
  WHY: A valid re-plan lands in ai:awaiting-approval with ai:scope-blocked. Aut
